title: Life Path Number 3: The Communicator
name: The Communicator
intro: Life Path 3 people are creative, joyful and expressive. They love words, art, humor and good company, and they light up every room with optimism.
weaknesses: Avoids hard work it finds boring
love: In love, 3s want fun, laughter and lots of conversation.
career: Writer, artist, presenter, marketer or content creator.
